## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm audit --omit=dev`

## Security and deployment review

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, mailbox contents, or personal data are included.
- [ ] Database changes include a versioned migration and RLS tests.
- [ ] Any deployment or migration steps are documented.
